description: Get one deal by its slug (the last part of its stackthedeal.com/deals/<slug>/ URL — a full deal-page URL also works), including whether it is still live. The deal links to its page on stackthedeal.com only — the retailer's link lives on that page.

slug.description: The deal slug, e.g. from a list_deals or search_deals result, or the deal's full stackthedeal.com URL.

name: get_deal
title: Get one deal by slug
